searched: The files: every file in this build. Our own index.html, js/*.js and the assets written by our own scripts in DrownedCity/Pipeline (Blender and numpy, seeded); assets/hero.glb and assets/reaver.glb start from two Microsoft Rocketbox avatars, changed by our scripts; vendor/three. Rocketbox's licence file is carried in licenses/.
mine: The game's code, rules, shaders, HUD and all its sound (Web Audio, no sound files); the world of Thalor: its seabed, coral, kelp, rock, ruins, statue, arena, shrines and bells; the whale, sharks, rays, turtles, jellies, fish, dolphins and the Leviathan (modelled by our Blender scripts); the Warden's armour, trident and mantle, the Reavers' armour and spears, and every swim and fight move (keyed by our Python scripts). The Warden and Thalor are original: not a comic-book character, not a famous game.
